results.injected_failure: The first worker durably claimed the recompilation job and then disappeared before compiling; its lease was forced past due.
results.restart_boundary: The first PostgreSQL pool was closed and a new pool represented the restarted process.

assertions: The authorization transition and pending recompilation job committed atomically before the injected process loss.
A new process reclaimed the expired lease with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
The deterministic compilation idempotency key produced one replacement Wiki.
The completed job cleared its lease and linked the replacement snapshot.
The original decision response was updated with the recovered compilation result.
A second worker restart found no work and created no duplicate projection.
Use-time authorization checks remain independent of worker availability.
limits: This proves local PostgreSQL recovery semantics, not managed-infrastructure alert delivery or a multi-region outage.
The evaluated source had one confirmed fact and no external connector write.
End-to-end transition-to-recompile latency monitoring is not yet exposed as an operator dashboard.
